title: Data visualization / Overview

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Make visual form serve accurate understanding so viewers can find a message without losing the integrity of the data.
strategic_value: A consistent IBM treatment that preserves quantity and context can support trust while making complex information approachable.
demonstration: The webpage presents a montage of dashboards and charts, followed by five criteria—Understandable, Essential, Impactful, Consistent and Contextual—each with explanatory copy and a video poster.
practical_value: Evaluate a proposed visualization for clarity, relevance, exploration, numerical integrity and audience context before choosing its styling.

content_islands.name: Introduction and examples
content_islands.spec: Place the purpose statement above a montage of analytical screens, charts and a dimensional data illustration.

content_islands.name: Understandable and Essential
content_islands.spec: Follow with two sections pairing rationale with black video posters of white circles; these are captured frames, not motion sequences.

content_islands.name: Impactful and Consistent
content_islands.spec: Continue with posters using small rectangular marks and numerical rows beside copy about exploration and proportional accuracy.

content_islands.name: Contextual
content_islands.spec: End with audience/context guidance and a poster of white blocks before ancillary navigation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The opening explains that visualization reveals stories in information; each criterion states why clarity, utility, exploration, numerical integrity or context matters.
reference_purposes.Expression: The montage shows IBM charts across light and dark interfaces, while the principle posters use spare geometric forms.
reference_purposes.Application: The criteria ask designers to choose an appropriate model, support exploration and adapt complexity to the audience and environment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The Consistent section requires visual representations to correspond to numerical quantities and preserve proportions and scale.
